nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 holding token balances; mutated by transfer/transferFrom and initialized in constructor.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 allowance; written by approve and read by transferFrom.
External IRC20 contract reference set in constructor; its raz() call is used as a transfer gate.
Total token supply, 10*10**12*10**18, minted entirely to the deployer in the constructor.
Token name string constant 'NanoInari'.
Token symbol stored as hex bytes 'NanoInari🦊'.
Token decimals, public uint set to 18.
Deployer-only constructor that sets wwwa and mints totalSupply to msg.sender.
Public view returning balances[owner]; used internally by transfer and transferFrom for balance checks.
Public transfer gated by an external call wwwa.raz(msg.sender) then mutates balances without overflow checks.
External view override that always returns 1; paired with the external wwwa.raz gate used to block transfers.
Public transferFrom gated by external wwwa.raz(from), balance and allowance checks, then mutates balances.
Public approval function writing allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value.
Caller-controlled address used for minting, balance mutation, allowance ownership and the external raz gate.
owner address parameter of balanceOf used to index the balances mapping.
Recipient address parameter of transfer, credited with value.
Amount parameter of transfer, added/subtracted on balances without SafeMath.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, debited and passed to the external raz gate.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom, credited with value.
Amount parameter of transferFrom, added/subtracted on balances without SafeMath.
Spender address parameter of approve, used as the allowance mapping key.
Allowance amount parameter of approve, written directly into the allowance mapping.
Account address parameter of raz; unused because raz always returns 1.
External call wwwa.raz(msg.sender) executed inside transfer that can revert or arbitrarily gate transfers.
External call wwwa.raz(from) executed inside transferFrom that can revert or arbitrarily gate transfers.
_info IRC20 parameter of the constructor, stored into the wwwa state variable.

edges.reason: msg.sender is untrusted caller input used to assign the entire initial supply inside the constructor.
msg.sender flows into the external raz gate and is the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is the allowance owner checked in transferFrom and drives the allowance debit.
msg.sender is the owner key of the allowance mapping written by approve.
The stored external contract wwwa is the call target of the raz gate in transfer.
The stored external contract wwwa is the call target of the raz gate in transferFrom.
The external raz call result controls execution of transfer through the require statement.
The external raz call result controls execution of transferFrom through the require statement.
balances is read and written in transfer with unchecked += and -= on amounts.
balances is read and written in transferFrom with unchecked += and -= on amounts.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping to return the owner balance.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping for from/msg.sender.
approve writes the value into the allowance mapping.
totalSupply is read by the constructor to mint the initial balance.
Constructor parameter _info is consumed by the constructor.
User-supplied _info is stored into the wwwa state variable that becomes the external call target.
The owner parameter indexes balances inside balanceOf.
The to parameter selects the credited account in transfer.
The value parameter is used in unchecked balance arithmetic inside transfer.
The from parameter is the debited account and the raz gate argument in transferFrom.
The to parameter selects the credited account in transferFrom.
The value parameter is used in unchecked balance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
The spender parameter is the allowance key in approve.
The value parameter is the allowance amount assigned in approve.
The account parameter is declared by raz but the function always returns 1.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter owner_balanceOf only serves as the balances mapping index inside balanceOf and carries no independent semantics.
Parameter to_transfer is only used as the credited account inside transfer.
Parameter value_transfer is only used in the unchecked balance arithmetic of transfer.
Parameter from_transferFrom is forwarded directly into the external raz call that gates transferFrom.
Parameter to_transferFrom is only used as the credited account inside transferFrom.
Parameter value_transferFrom is only used in the unchecked balance arithmetic of transferFrom.
Parameter spender_approve is only used as the allowance mapping key inside approve.
Parameter value_approve is only used as the allowance amount inside approve.
Parameter account_raz is never used since raz unconditionally returns 1.
Constructor parameter _info is only used to set the wwwa external contract reference.
